scalar_existing.equation: L_scalar = sum_o [1/2 d_mu Psi_o^dag d^mu Psi_o - V_o(|Psi_o|^2)] - 1/2 sum_{o!=o'} K_{oo'} Psi_o^dag Psi_{o'}

spinor_kinetic_extension.equation: L_psi = sum_i bar(psi_i) (i gamma^mu D_mu - m_i) psi_i

yukawa_extension.equation: L_Y = - sum_{ij} [ y^u_ij bar(Q_i) tilde(H) u_j + y^d_ij bar(Q_i) H d_j + y^e_ij bar(L_i) H e_j ] + h.c.

gauge_kinetic_extension.equation: L_gauge = -1/4 G^a_{mu nu} G^{a mu nu} -1/4 W^i_{mu nu} W^{i mu nu} -1/4 B_{mu nu} B^{mu nu}

covariant_derivative.equation: D_mu = partial_mu - i g_s T^a G^a_mu - i g tau^i W^i_mu - i g' Y B_mu

gravity_bridge_statement.equation: G_{mu nu}(g_eff) = 8 pi G_eff T_{mu nu}^{eff} + Delta_{mu nu}^{UV}
